QuestInfo.name: [Alliance] Lilin's Call
QuestInfo.0: You received a surprise message from #p1105012#!
QuestInfo.1: #p1105012# wants you to come to #m140000000# to see something she found.
QuestInfo.2: #p1105012# showed you an invitation, from the #p1101000# Knights, to their Continental Conference. If the conference is a success, the Maple Alliance will emerge strong and solid. Lilin is excited to see you finally being recognized as a true Hero.

0.0: Aran! Is your training going well? I know you're probably busy, but I have some really great news! I'd really like to tell you in person. Please come over to #m140000000# as soon as you can. I miss you!

no.0: Knee deep in training as always? That's the only way you'll get stronger! Hey, do you think you could bring me a Horntail scale as a gift next time you come this way?

1.0: You really came! I'm so excited to show you! Look! At the letter, not the envelope, silly! The #p1101000# Knights sent it. They want to recognize you as a true hero!

yes.0: It says that Empress #p1101000# wants to create a Maple Alliance in order to confront the Black Mage. She's holding a continental conference for qualified warriors to go over the details and decide on how to proceed. She wants YOU to come!
yes.1: Everybody knows you're the real deal now! This is so exciting! The whole continent knows you're a hero!
